rawFindings.title: Incorrect handling of leading slash in isCurrentHelper
rawFindings.explanation: The original code ensured the 'path' and 'this.path' always had a leading '/' by replacing initial characters if missing, allowing consistent comparison. The new code removes this, so paths without a leading slash won't match correctly, causing false negatives on current path checks.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore logic to add a leading slash to 'path' and 'this.path' if missing before comparison in isCurrentHelper.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Calling is.current with this.path='index.html' and path='index.html' returns false instead of true, because 'index.html' and 'index.html' without leading slash do not match current checks expecting leading slash.
